## 2. Technical Capabilities & Technology Stack

### A. Artificial Intelligence, Multimodels & MCP Servers
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** MCP servers development, tool declarations, resource handlers, agentic workflows.
- **Multimodal AI & Context Management:** LLM API integration, multi-turn context curation, prompt engineering, structured JSON output extraction.
- **AI Automation & Agents:** Agentic pipelines, autonomous problem solving, tool routing.

### B. Desktop Software (PC) & Systems Programming
- **C# / .NET:** WinForms, WPF, background workers, custom UI tooling, system utilities.
- **C++:** Native high-performance applications, file manipulation algorithms, OS-level interaction.
- **Windows APIs:** Process management, file system listeners, custom desktop automation.

### C. Mobile Applications
- **Multiplatform Mobile:** React Native, cross-platform mobile interfaces, touch gestures, offline-first architectures.
- **Mobile UI/UX:** Responsive layouts, adaptive styling, REST API integration.

### D. Full-Stack Web, Caching & E-Commerce
- **Frontend:** Next.js 15 & 16 (App Router, Server Actions), React 19 / 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand with persist middleware, Framer Motion, Vite.
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, NextAuth v5 (Auth.js) with JWT & Discord OAuth2, Python (FastAPI, standard libraries), Serverless Functions (Netlify).
- **Caching & In-Memory Data:** Redis & Redis Cache (high-speed data caching, session store, rate limiting, pub/sub messaging).
- **Security & Tokens:** JWT (JSON Web Tokens) stateless token authentication, Bcrypt password hashing, anti-DDoS rate limiters.
- **Databases & ORMs:** PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM (v7), Supabase (Auth, Storage, Database), SQLite, MongoDB.
- **Payment Gateways & APIs:** Stripe API & Webhooks, AbacatePay (Instant PIX with webhooks), Mercado Pago (transparent checkout with Base64 QR code and polling), Resend (transactional email), Nominatim OpenStreetMap (geocoding & distance calculation).

### E. Bot Development & Real-Time Integrations
- **discord.js (v14):** REST interactions, Slash commands endpoints, Discord OAuth2 auto-join, guild moderation.
- **discord.py (Python 3.10+):** Modular architectures with Cogs, custom JSON webhook builders, event handlers.
- **Roblox Luau:** Client/Server network synchronization, HttpService REST bridges to Express backends, data persistence, 60 FPS mobile optimization.

## 3. Detailed Portfolio Projects & Case Studies

### Case Study 1: BloodStore — Digital E-Commerce (Sold Project)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/xsag7/bloodstore3
- **Owner / Client:** Sold and transferred to @xsag7
- **Role:** Original Creator & Full-Stack Architect
- **Tech Stack:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Netlify Functions.
- **Key Deliverables:** Automated digital product store with cloud database persistence via Supabase, serverless API execution via Netlify Functions, and clean transfer to commercial buyer.
- **Development Time:** ~60h

### Case Study 2: Sagaz Site — Digital Goods & Instant PIX Recharging Platform
- **Repository:** https://github.com/safadaooofc/sagaz-site
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer & Bot Architect
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Tailwind UI, PostgreSQL, Prisma v7, NextAuth.js v5, discord.js v14, Resend, AbacatePay REST API.
- **Key Deliverables:** Automated PIX billing and instant confirmation via Webhook, interactive rewards linked to Discord bot v14, RBAC admin dashboard, and audit logging.
- **Development Time:** ~90h

### Case Study 3: Luxury Sales — Digital Game Keys E-Commerce
- **Repository:** https://github.com/safadaooofc/luxury-sales-site
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, NextAuth v5, Zustand, Lucide React.
- **Key Deliverables:** Dual authentication (Credentials + Discord OAuth with automatic guild join), anti-spam rate limiting in memory, complex product variants (Standard/Deluxe, Steam/PSN/Xbox), Zustand global shopping cart with persist, and admin dashboard with sales charts and customer chat logs.
- **Development Time:** ~85h

### Case Study 4: Alma Criativa Confeitaria — Full-Stack E-Commerce & Product Configurator
- **Live URL:** https://almacriativa.netlify.app
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer
- **Tech Stack:** React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Mercado Pago API, Nominatim OpenStreetMap API, Framer Motion.
- **Key Deliverables:** Multi-layer interactive configurators ("Build your Cake", "Build your Party Kit"), transparent Mercado Pago checkout (PIX dynamic Base64 QR code + 4s status polling and credit card), dynamic freight engine calculating distance to headquarters via Nominatim API, and advance-notice calendar.
